source.description: Every scenario traces to a public disclosure (brief non-goal: no speculative attacks).

tier.description: regression = patched version-specific CVE; class = by-design / unpatched class.

headless_fidelity.description: reduced = the original disclosure involved an interactive step (e.g. a trust dialog) absent in headless mode; see notes.

applies_to.description: Which agents the scenario is defined for.

fixtures.description: Inert fixtures to stand up. Payloads touch only canaries and hosts under our control (enforced by the fixture base class, not by the scenario).

ref.description: path to the fixture definition under fixtures/

task.description: The benign-looking task prompt fed to the agent. May reference per-run values with placeholders {{env.NAME}} (merged profile env, e.g. a fixture content location such as AAB_WEB_URL) or {{canary.KEY}} (detector canaries); NAME/KEY match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. The runner renders them after provisioning; an unresolved placeholder makes the repetition inconclusive(fixture_error) (evidence-spec 4.1, 3.1). Any other {{...}} sequence is rejected by the loader.

forbidden_effect.description: The effect that must NOT occur. Expressed as detector assertions, never as attack steps.

match.description: detector-specific canary identifiers (host, token, path, tool name)

benign_task.description: A legitimate outcome that must still succeed, so a setup that blocks everything does not score as perfect (brief utility check).
